system_facts.summary: All eight registered professional uses are operated by the EU programme team in Dublin. The September-authored owner context reports observations for August 26.

citations.quote: This review concerns Quillhaven Academy's EU programme team operating from Dublin, Ireland. That team administers all eight registered uses for its professional work; the learners, applicants and staff concerned include people in Ireland, and the public campaign and programme outputs are used there. None of these uses is personal, military, national-security or law-enforcement activity. The systems are operating services, not research-only prototypes.

system_facts.summary: Learner Support Chat: Answers routine learner questions. Register values and retrospective owner use description are reports, not independently inspected deployment proof.

citations.quote: Learner Support Chat

Learners exchange questions and generated replies directly with the licensed support chat. It does not classify biometric data or infer emotions or intentions. The existing notice and evidence reports remain the source for disclosure practice.

For AI-001, AI-002, AI-003, AI-004, AI-006, AI-007 and AI-008, Quillhaven licenses and operates a third-party supplier's existing AI product. It did not develop or commission development of that product, distribute it as its own AI product, or place it into service under its own product name or trademark. The register's system names are internal inventory labels. Company content, ordinary settings and website placement do not describe a separately developed Quillhaven AI product. The current AI-005 release's development, commissioning and product-branding records are still awaiting the Assessment Operations owner refresh; the old questionnaire does not resolve them.

system_facts.summary: Video Localisation Tool: Generates dubbed public programme videos. Register values and retrospective owner use description are reports, not independently inspected deployment proof.

citations.quote: Video Localisation Tool

Communications uses the supplier's product to create translated speech and adjusted lip movements for recorded programme presenters. The presenters are real people; the altered recording makes them appear to speak words in a language they did not actually record, and a viewer could mistake it for an authentic recording without disclosure. The videos communicate programme information, not an evidently artistic, satirical or fictional performance. The visible-label report, untested provenance and unapproved exception request remain exactly as recorded.

system_facts.summary: Operations reports supplier products first offered commercially in the EU on June 1, 2026. Product entry differs from output publication and does not identify Quillhaven as provider; the release notices themselves were not retrieved.

citations.quote: The suppliers' product-release notices held by Operations report that the currently licensed image-generation product used for AI-003 and audio/video-generation product used for AI-008 were first offered commercially in the EU on 1 June 2026. These are product market-entry dates, not the dates Quillhaven exported or published individual images or videos. They do not identify Quillhaven as the supplier. Current release and market-entry evidence for AI-005 remains unavailable.

policy_controls.summary: The August internal policy requires clear notice before or at first direct interaction unless the AI nature is obvious. It governs company practice separately from supplier statutory duties.

citations.quote: A person directly interacting with an AI system must receive a clear notice before or at the first interaction unless the AI nature is obvious from the context.

policy_controls.summary: The August policy requires public synthetic media to retain machine-readable provenance when the tool supports it, and a visible label unless Legal approves a documented exception.

citations.quote: Public synthetic images, audio, or video must retain machine-readable provenance when the tool supports it. The Communications owner also requires a visible label unless Legal approves a documented exception.

policy_controls.summary: Staff-only drafting is not automatically public interaction; owners must record how generated outputs reach learners or the public.

citations.quote: Staff-only drafting tools are not automatically treated as public interactions. The owner must still record how generated material reaches learners or the public.

policy_controls.summary: Each system needs current owner, use, exposure, disclosure, human-review and evidence records. Missing, stale, conflicting and not-applicable evidence states do not determine compliance.

citations.quote: Each registered system must have a current owner, use description, exposed group, disclosure status, human-review path, and evidence reference.
missing, stale, conflicting, and not-applicable are different evidence states. Missing evidence must not be converted to compliance or non-compliance.

policy_controls.summary: An exception requires a named owner, rationale, expiry and Legal approval. The automation may draft a request but cannot approve it.

citations.quote: An exception requires a named owner, rationale, expiry date, and Legal approval. The automation may draft an exception request but may not approve it.

policy_controls.summary: Legal owns interpretation and exceptions; Operations owns activation and deadlines; system owners correct evidence. This package remains a pending draft.

citations.quote: Legal owns final interpretation of the EU AI Act. Operations owns policy activation and operational deadlines. System owners correct evidence. The automation may prepare a draft impact package and proposed actions; it may not give final legal advice, activate policy, change a production deadline, close an incident, or submit an official response.

options: Treat current records as contemporaneous proof
Bounded retrospective draft with explicit limits
decisions.chosen_behavior: Bounded retrospective draft with explicit historical limits
decisions.rationale: The binding acts predate the review and live company reports support conditional proposals; missing proof remains unresolved.
tradeoffs: Historical compliance cannot be verified; system owners and Legal must review the draft.
